name: restaurant-business-software
description: Full-stack restaurant business management software (POS, menu, tables, reservations, inventory, staff, dashboard).

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run db:setup
scripts.db:setup: npm run prisma:migrate --prefix backend && npm run seed --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
